premises.name: QFORM-RANK2-AFFINE-HALF-RIESZ-v1
premises.scope: rank-two quadratic form in an orthonormal physical projection plus arbitrary original-coordinate affine term; half-Riesz bound 128 |det Lambda|^-1/4; 16 sqrt(30) if affine term lies in the rank-two range

partner_result_applied.result: heavy-row conditioned rank-two residual bound with factor 2*3^(1/4)*sqrt(pi e)*(1-c)^(-1/4)
partner_result_applied.application: combined with the new whole-principal-patch bound to remove the c->1 blow-up in the pure quadratic exact-rank-two residual branch

new_result.statement: For physical pivot a=A_ii!=0 and Schur complement S, if an original-coordinate principal patch H=S[J,J] has exact rank two with nonzero eigenvalues mu1,mu2, then the full ambient quadratic form has an essentially bounded density with norm <=128 |a|^-1/2 |mu1 mu2|^-1/4, with arbitrary outside quadratic terms and cross couplings. If range(S[J,Jc]) is contained in range(H), replace 128 by 16 sqrt(30).

unresolved_implication: Replace the exact rank-two principal Schur patch hypothesis by a higher-rank/product-preserving condition forced by the bare three-large-eigenvalue assumption, while controlling arbitrary additional Schur curvature without selecting a shrinking single minor.
next_step: Attempt a dependence-safe splice of the orientation-free rank-two half-Riesz theorem with the existing ridge/diffuse estimate on orthogonal residual curvature.
